manualChecklist.text: Test with a real screen reader (NVDA or JAWS on Windows, VoiceOver on macOS/iOS).
manualChecklist.why: No automated tool, and no simulator, reproduces real AT behaviour — NVDA, JAWS and VoiceOver diverge from each other and from the specification.

manualChecklist.text: Tab through the page and confirm the focus order is logical, not merely present.
manualChecklist.why: a11y-loop can see that focus moves and where it goes, but whether the sequence makes sense for this content is a human judgment.

manualChecklist.text: Complete the page’s main task using only the keyboard.
manualChecklist.why: Automated checks probe individual controls; they do not know what the user is trying to accomplish.

manualChecklist.text: Read each link text out of context and confirm the destination is still clear.
manualChecklist.why: SC 2.4.4 permits vague link text when the surrounding context supplies the purpose — whether it does is a judgment call.

manualChecklist.text: Confirm the heading structure describes the content hierarchy, not the visual sizes.
manualChecklist.why: Automation can detect skipped levels but not whether the outline reflects the actual structure of the page.

manualChecklist.text: Confirm colour is never the only way information is conveyed.
manualChecklist.why: SC 1.4.1 is one of the criteria no tool can test: recognising that "the required fields are in red" needs comprehension of the content.

manualChecklist.text: Check the contrast of the elements axe could not measure by hand (WebAIM Contrast Checker, or a11y-loop contrast <fg> <bg>).
manualChecklist.why: axe gives up on background images, gradients, pseudo-element backgrounds and foreground opacity or occlusion, and reports them as incomplete. A computed ratio of 1:1 is the usual tell.

manualChecklist.text: Check the contrast of hover and focus states.
manualChecklist.why: No engine checks state contrast unless the state is driven and re-scanned. Use --interact to add hover and focus states to the audit.
